text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby. Having 
undergone ideal training, Mejiro Bright 
enters the race in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Silence Suzuka harbored doubts 
even right before the race, unable to 
envision her ideal style of running.
